cover.sub: 5 niche things that will make you
cover.title: dangerously good at nis2

inner.title: check your size
inner.body: nis2 covers medium and large firms in sectors like cloud, data centres and online marketplaces. being small is the only exemption, and it expires.
inner.label: growing into it

inner.title: mfa is the law
inner.body: article 21 lists multi-factor authentication among the minimum measures, next to backups and encryption. a shared admin password is now a compliance gap.
inner.label: shared logins

inner.title: the 24 hour warning
inner.body: a significant incident needs an early warning to your csirt within 24 hours, a notification within 72. the final report follows a month later.
inner.label: 24h clock

inner.title: the board trains too
inner.body: management bodies must approve the security measures and follow cybersecurity training. enisa says they can be held liable for infringements.
inner.label: your name on it

inner.title: suppliers count
inner.body: article 21 makes supply chain security a minimum measure for covered firms. customers facing fines of €10m or 2% of turnover will check you first.
inner.label: be the safe pick

closer.HEADLINE:
nis2 isn't a burden.
it's a sales pitch
closer.TONIGHT: turn on mfa for every admin
closer.CTA: comment 24 if you couldn't report in a day
